source_documents.title: Role of Conical Intersections on the Efficiency of Fluorescent Organic Molecular Crystals

reference_evidence_units.subject: HBT
reference_evidence_units.conditions: HBT solution/vacuum versus herringbone crystal; TDDFT/OEEC and CASPT2 checks; literature powder quantum yield.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The paper reports aggregate enhancement up to QEF 0.77 in powder, compared with negligible organic-solution yield.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Powder result is cited from prior literature, not measured here; avoid describing it as a single-crystal quantum yield.

reference_evidence_units.quote: ESIPT is energetically more favorable in both solution/crystal, releasing 0.38/0.39 eV
reference_evidence_units.subject: HBT
reference_evidence_units.conditions: HBT solution/vacuum versus herringbone crystal; TDDFT/OEEC and CASPT2 checks; literature powder quantum yield.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Computed ESIPT relaxation favors cis-keto formation in both media.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Energetic optimization does not quantify proton-transfer yield or rate.

reference_evidence_units.quote: it has a minor eﬀect on the ﬂuorescence rate of the cis-keto form
reference_evidence_units.subject: HBT
reference_evidence_units.conditions: HBT solution/vacuum versus herringbone crystal; TDDFT/OEEC and CASPT2 checks; literature powder quantum yield.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Crystallization has little calculated effect on the emissive cis-keto radiative rate; Table 2 gives 0.41 versus 0.35 ns^-1 in cyclohexane and crystal.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Table 2 and Figure 6 visually inspected; enol rates must not be transferred to keto emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the crystal MECI remains unstable, surpassing the absorption energy by 1.9 eV.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HBT
reference_evidence_units.conditions: HBT solution/vacuum versus herringbone crystal; TDDFT/OEEC and CASPT2 checks; literature powder quantum yield.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The crystal CI requires additional pyramidalization and lies 1.9 eV above absorption in TDDFT.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: CASPT2 on those geometries gives 2.05 eV above absorption with a residual 0.36 eV S1-S0 gap; not an exact multireference optimized degeneracy.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Upon crystallization, the S1−S0 MECI becomes inaccessible for a molecule excited at the FC point.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HBT
reference_evidence_units.conditions: HBT solution/vacuum versus herringbone crystal; TDDFT/OEEC and CASPT2 checks; literature powder quantum yield.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors identify loss of the principal CI-mediated decay route as the explanation for enhanced QEF.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: An energetic-accessibility interpretation, not measured nonadiabatic dynamics.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the reorganization energies of low-frequency modes are not signiﬁcantly hampered in the aggregate phase.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HBT
reference_evidence_units.conditions: HBT solution/vacuum versus herringbone crystal; TDDFT/OEEC and CASPT2 checks; literature powder quantum yield.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Normal-mode analysis does not show substantial low-frequency vibrational suppression in HBT.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Harmonic representation misses the high-amplitude anharmonic torsion leading to CI; it does not rule out all motion effects.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The eﬀect of photon reabsorption is minimized in the HBT crystal because of a signiﬁcant Stokes shift
reference_evidence_units.subject: HBT
reference_evidence_units.conditions: HBT solution/vacuum versus herringbone crystal; TDDFT/OEEC and CASPT2 checks; literature powder quantum yield.
reference_evidence_units.statement: ESIPT separates enol absorption from cis-keto emission and reduces reabsorption.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Not an independent exciton or anti-Kasha emission assignment.

reference_evidence_units.quote: exciton hopping is expected to be a slower process compared to intramolecular relaxation.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HBT
reference_evidence_units.conditions: HBT solution/vacuum versus herringbone crystal; TDDFT/OEEC and CASPT2 checks; literature powder quantum yield.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Small exciton coupling of 0.036 eV relative to enol reorganization of 0.28 eV is used to discount rapid hopping.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A relative-rate expectation; hopping was not directly measured.

reference_evidence_units.quote: herringbone packing eﬀectively blocked rotations about the principal axis
reference_evidence_units.subject: HBT
reference_evidence_units.conditions: HBT solution/vacuum versus herringbone crystal; TDDFT/OEEC and CASPT2 checks; literature powder quantum yield.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Herringbone steric restrictions are identified as the environmental reason for CI destabilization.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The conclusion also discusses alpha-DCS sheet packing; this evidence is restricted to HBT's herringbone context.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Herringbone neighbors hinder the large distortions needed for internal conversion.

reference_mechanisms.label: ESIPT_PT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Enol-to-cis-keto ESIPT establishes the emitting state and large Stokes shift; it is not itself shown to be the origin of yield enhancement.

reference_mechanisms.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The main source explanation is crystal destabilization of the CI that is accessible through torsion in isolated HBT.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The tested harmonic low-frequency RIM explanation is explicitly not supported. CI-reaching torsion is retained under RACI.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Herringbone neighbors hinder the large distortions needed for internal conversion.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No guest binding, pore uptake or host inclusion mechanism is established; a solvent or self-assembly is not automatically host-guest chemistry.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific CT or TICT mechanism is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Enol-to-cis-keto ESIPT establishes the emitting state and large Stokes shift; it is not itself shown to be the origin of yield enhancement.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on is established; energy transfer and CT character are not by themselves PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Weak exciton coupling and slow expected hopping are contextual negative controls, not the source's enhancement mechanism.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The source finds little change of the relevant keto radiative rate. Do not use the enol rate increase to explain keto emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No operative target-specific triplet or metal-mediated pathway is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The main source explanation is crystal destabilization of the CI that is accessible through torsion in isolated HBT.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-singlet-state emission or anti-Kasha mechanism is established; higher-state absorption alone is insufficient.
